periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Inwardly tilted at approximately 45 degrees toward the sagittal plane relative to the horizontal facial axis.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with the inferior margin extending significantly lower than the geometric center toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth, wide U-shaped curve along the posterior edge of the band across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, uniformly rounded semicircular top boundary.
